entities.summary: Keith Kensel Owens is an American former professional basketball player for the Los Angeles Lakers in the National Basketball Association (NBA). The small forward played one season with the Lakers in the 1991–92 season. He played college basketball for four seasons for the UCLA Bruins from 1987 through 1991.
